payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the pretrained word embeddings used in the study, including GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings, as well as emoji embeddings derived from emoji descriptions.

claims.text: The pretrained word embeddings used include 200-dimensional GloVe embeddings trained on 2 billion tweets.
Edinburgh embeddings were obtained by training a skip-gram model on the Edinburgh corpus.
Emoji embeddings learned from emoji descriptions were also utilized in the system.
